title: Unbind a Spark Ad post
content_data:
Use this endpoint to unbind a Spark Ad post after the authorization has expired or has been revoked. To unbind a Spark Ad post is to remove the post from the list of authorized Spark Ad posts for the ad account. ## Comparing v1.2 and v1.3 The following table outlines the differences between v1.2 and v1.3 endpoints. ```xtable |Changes{30%}|v1.2{35%}|v1.3{35%}| |---|---|---| |Endpoint path| /v1.2/tt_video/unbind/| /v1.3/tt_video/unbind/| |Request parameter data type |`advertiser_id`: number
`item_id`:number |`advertiser_id`: string
`item_id`:string| ``` ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/tt_video/unbind/ **Method** POST **Header** ``` xtable |Field|Type|Description| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {required}|string|Authorized access token. For details, see [Authentication](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1738373164380162).| |Content-Type {required}|string| The content type of the request.
Allowed value: `"application/json"` | ``` **Parameters** ``` xtable |Field|Type|Description| |--- |--- |--- | |advertiser_id {required}|string|The advertiser ID| |item_id {required}|string| The ID of the Spark Ads post | ``` ### Example ``` xcodeblock (code curl http) curl -H "Access-Token:xxx" -H "Content-Type:application/json" -X POST \ -d '{ "advertiser_id": "ADVERTISER_ID", "item_id": "ITEM_ID" }' \ https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/tt_video/unbind/ (/code) ``` ## Response ``` xtable |Field|Type|Description| |---|---|---| |message|string|The return message. For details, see [Appendix-Return information](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |code |number|The return code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix-Return Code](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097). | |data |object|The returned data| |request_id |string|The unique log ID of the request. | ``` ### Example ``` xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "message": "OK", "code": 0, "data": {} } (/code); ```
